$comment: Dev-workflow AI governance hooks (spec 34). Governs the Claude Code assistant working on this repo: redacted audit trail, secret-write block, and a session summary. Scripts resolve their own paths via __file__, so output is cwd-independent; the command paths assume hooks run with the project root as cwd (Claude Code default) and python on PATH. Logs land in gitignored .claude/audit/. Disable with "disableAllHooks": true or by removing this file. Review tools/hooks/*.py before trusting (hooks run local commands).
